_doc: Special-enemy knowledge (Update 03 section 2), keyed by Zombie.enemy_id; `default` fills what an entry leaves out. Read by bot_perception.gd (threat) and bot_aim.gd (targets, aim points, melee, grenades) whenever such an enemy is on the map; entries for enemies that don't exist yet (Paul, the Slender, Frostbiss, Bergwacht, the Treibstoff-Gaenger) are ready for when they do. threat_mult: the type multiplier in the threat score. aim: head / chest / weak_point. head_bias: added to the headshot preference. focus_when_vulnerable: priority x vulnerable_priority while the boss takes extra damage (HomageBoss.damage_taken_mult() > 1: the Hammer's mallet in the air, Alix kneeling at a fallen cousin's hand). break_grab: shoot the grabbing limb (HomageArm weak points: the Reach's wrists) the moment it holds a teammate (priority x grab_priority). keep_distance_m: a danger zone of that radius rides on it (the locomotion layer avoids it; inside it the bot backs off). never_melee: no knife, ever. explosives: grenades and launchers are good on it. no_fire_near_teammates_m: no fire weapon kills while a teammate is that close to it. adds_first_m / adds_first_mult (T-058): while an ordinary zombie is within adds_first_m of the bot, this boss's target value is x adds_first_mult (the runner at its heels first), unless the boss is vulnerable or grabbing someone. hold_ground (T-058): too fast to back away from or outrun: no backpedal, no sprint-away, stand together and shoot. spread_out: bots keep spread_m apart while it lives (never all in one cone). boss: counts as a boss for grenades and the 'bosses in general' rules. reach_m (T-071): how far it hits from (its swing plus a lunge): the player bot's training gap.

bellringer._note: T-058: 5.4 m/s with a 2 m lunge: nobody outruns them. Stand together back to back and shoot (no backpedal, no sprinting off alone).

cousin_hammer._note: shoot her while the mallet is in flight (x1.5 damage taken then)

cousin_reach._note: shoot the glowing wrist the moment she holds a teammate

cousin_alix._note: never within 2 m (the Holding Hand); focus her while she holds a fallen cousin's hand

paul._note: not in the game yet: shoot the IV bottles at rage > 66, stay out of the leap-shadow, flank to the neck

slender._note: not in the game yet: stay in light, don't stare, ignore decoys, shoot the lantern when a teammate is quarantined

frostbiss._note: not in the game yet: keep distance

bergwacht._note: not in the game yet: watch the walls

treibstoff_ganger._note: not in the game yet: no fire kills near teammates
